name: Dual Monitor Wallpaper
author: vpinto
description: Two distinct wallpapers, one per monitor: the left monitor shows the image whose name ends in _L, the right one the one ending in _R. Configures the wallpaper folder and which monitor is left/right.

barWidget.description: Pick the wallpaper folder and which monitor is the left and the right one. Left shows the image ending in _L, right the one ending in _R.
